not_installed_yet.what_installing_means: The parser becomes a rule file of this generation; the D01 route needs a successor preparation and v1 candidate chain to reach it, because those four functions look each other up as module globals in a frozen module; and audit_report_spans gains `not linked`, which is one line in a rule file this generation already owns.
not_installed_yet.why: A rule file cannot move while the batch that is the evidence for this closure is still running.

the_parser.shape: A subclass of text_coverage._Blocks that keeps a bold stack and an underline stack beside the frozen emphasis flag. The bold stack restates the frozen font-weight rule so that inheritance is read from the bold component rather than from the combined flag, which is what makes `none` cancel an underline and nothing else.
the_parser.the_copied_rule_is_held_to_the_original: With admit_underline=False the subclass must produce blocks identical to the frozen parser. Measured over every saved filing above 400 KB: identical on all of them, with no exceptions.
the_parser.with_underline_on_it_only_adds: Zero leading emphases cleared and zero shrunk on every document. The monotone property is a consequence of the two stacks, not an assumption.

the_probe_that_measured_this_was_itself_.and_dropping_the_cancel_is_not_the_fix_e: Measured too: a monotone rule that ignores `none` entirely differs from the cancelling one on nine documents - 1,605 blocks in the Salesforce proxy, five in Pfizer's 10-K - so `none` does carry information. The answer is two stacks, not one flag and not no cancel.
the_probe_that_measured_this_was_itself_.what_it_did: The first two measurements admitted underline by setting the frozen emphasis flag on `text-decoration:underline` and clearing it on `text-decoration:none`. One flag cannot tell which contribution it is clearing, so a `none` under a bold ancestor clears the bold.
the_probe_that_measured_this_was_itself_.why_it_still_reported_nothing_else_movin: Luck, not design: none of the mangled blocks happened to be inside a scanned range of the three metrics. A measurement whose instrument does something other than what it says is not evidence, even when its answer turns out to be right - so every conclusion drawn from it was re-derived with the parser below.

three_way_re_derived.everything_else: Unchanged. Twenty-four of the twenty-seven readable company-metric pairs return the frozen answer exactly on all three sides.
